name: Mövenpick Resort Khao Yai
short_description: A European-chateau-style countryside resort in Pak Chong near Khao Yai National Park, with rooms, suites, penthouses, and pool villas set around an 18-hole golf course.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Resort Khao Yai is a 5-star countryside resort at 334 Moo 6, Tambon Wang Sai, Pak Chong district, Nakhon Ratchasima -- roughly a 3-hour drive from Bangkok and about 20 minutes from Khao Yai National Park. Its grand European-chateau architecture, sweeping staircases, and manicured grounds wrap around the on-site 18-hole Starry Valley Golf Club, with accommodation spanning standard rooms up to multi-bedroom pool villas, plus indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, and several restaurants including an Italian option guests repeatedly single out. Guest reviews are strongly positive on the grand architecture, spacious rooms, and attentive service, with a 2025 blog review noting the resort suits a destination-style countryside escape better than a base for daily national-park sightseeing given the drive involved.

faqs.question: How far is Mövenpick Resort Khao Yai from Khao Yai National Park?
faqs.answer: The resort sits in Pak Chong district, about a 20-minute drive from the Khao Yai National Park entrance. It's positioned more as a destination countryside resort in its own right -- with golf, pools, and villas -- than as a basecamp for daily park visits, so guests focused on hiking may prefer a lodge closer to the gate.

faqs.question: Does Mövenpick Resort Khao Yai have a golf course?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the on-site Starry Valley Golf Club is an 18-hole course with mountain views, and it's one of the resort's signature amenities alongside indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, and accommodation ranging from standard rooms up to multi-bedroom pool villas set apart from the main building.
